title: Austin Fine Remission & Drivers Licenses
summary:
*   Approved the remission of a Recorder's Court fine for citizen Ed Johnson, following a petition.
*   Granted new drivers' licenses to three applicants: E.B. Earnest, Geo. Fiegel Jr., and J.M. Benson.
*   Received and filed routine reports from city departments, including the Assessor & Collector, Superintendent of Streets & Sewers, and the Marshal.
transcript:
321
.Regular meeting of the City Council : Austin, Texas, August 05, 1915.
Hon E C Bartholomew, Mayor, pro tem,presiding:Roll called : Councilmen Anthony,
Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 4
Absent excused, Mayor Wooldridge 1
The minutes of the last regular and subsequent recessed meetings were read and approved.

Reports of City Officers:

The Chair laid before the Council the following reports,which were read and ordered filed:
Assessor & collector, Supt Streets & Sewers,Marshal Councilman Anthony to whom was refered
the petition of Ed Johnson to have finein Recorders Court remitted, presente a verbal
report recommending that the petition be granted.The recommendation was adopted by the
following vote : Yeas Councilmen Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 4 Nays none.
Drivers license wre granted to the following named applicants;
E B Earnest, 1701 Chicon Street.
Geo Fiegel Jr 606 Guadalupe street.
J M Benson , 1403 Garden street.
The Council then adjourned.
Ed Johnson
Fine remitted

Drivers license
Jno. Johnson
City Clerk
